name: Brisbane Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways: 01R/19L, 45 m wide, up to 3,560 m take-off run (19L; 3,500 m from 01R); 01L/19R, 60 m wide, 3,300 m

curfew.v: no curfew; the airport operator welcomed the federal decision to keep Brisbane curfew free (2014 statement)
curfew.quote: Brisbane Airport Corporation (BAC) welcomes the Federal Government's decision to keep Brisbane Airport curfew free.

slots.v: all operators need a slot from Capacity Optimisation Group (COG) before flying into or out of Brisbane; from 15 Jan 2026, slots between 00:00 and 03:59 local go only to aircraft certified to ICAO Annex 16 Chapter 14 noise levels, except historic slots as at that date, state and humanitarian flights and certain domestic freight; 'ad hoc movements' rank first on the General Aviation Apron
slots.quote: All operators will require a slot allocation by COG before operating a flight into and out of Brisbane Airport. ... With effect from 15 January 2026, Sensitive Hours Slots will only be allocated to Night-time Noise Compliant Aircraft

ppr.v: aircraft parking is requested from the airport operator by email or phone, 24 hours
ppr.quote: ACFT parking requests email or PH AD OPR H24.

max_aircraft.v: the southern taxilane of the GA apron takes aircraft up to 24 m wingspan
max_aircraft.quote: GA APN southern taxilane restricted to 24M MAX wingspan.

fuel.v: Jet A-1 24 hours from BP Air Refuel, Ampol Aviation and Viva Energy (Jet Valet and GA, also Avgas)
fuel.quote: Ampol Aviation: H24. PH: 0438 753 572. JET A1.

noise.v: noise abatement procedures in AIP DAP; during SODPROPS outside 22:00-06:00 local, arrivals may be delayed up to 20 minutes

permits.v: aircraft carrying dangerous goods or livestock need 4 days' notice and prior approval
permits.quote: ACFT transporting dangerous goods or livestock require 4 days notice and prior approval.

hours.v: the general aviation precinct offers airside access to charter flights 24/7 (precinct statement; the aerodrome's own hours are not stated)
hours.quote: offers direct airside access to charter flight operations 24/7.

handling.v: anyone doing ground handling on common user aprons must hold an Airport Operating Licence from the airport
handling.quote: Any operator wishing to conduct Ground Handling on common user aprons are required to hold an Airport Operating Licence.

missing: handling (the operator's list gives providers without saying who does what)
